title: A History of The ARM Microprocessor | Dave Jaggar | Talks at Google
summary: Dave Jaggar, who defined much of the ARM architecture, recounts how Acorn's near-extinction led to ARM, including the history of Thumb, StrongARM, and the Austin team.
why: HN cites it for first-hand ARM history, including Thumb's origin, and for Jaggar's endorsement of RISC-V.

quote.text: Dave Jaggar has some interesting comments on the history around DEC, StrongARM and the Austin ARM team.
